posts.title: Watching RTE Player abroad with a Tailscale app connector
posts.description: RTE Player, like most Irish broadcasters, is geo locked to Ireland. When I am abroad I still want to watch it, but I have no interest in routing my entire phone through a VPN to get at it. My banking app, my email and everything else can stay on the local connection. I only want the traffic that talks to RTE to look like it is coming from home. The tidy way to do this is a Tailscale app connector.
